articles.title: Big School Survey Shows More Preschoolers and More Suspensions
articles.summary: A big government survey of public schools found more kids in preschool, more suspensions and teachers who look very different from their students.

articles.title: ABC Asks a Judge to Stop an Early Check of Its TV Licenses
articles.summary: ABC says an early government check of its TV licenses goes against free speech. A judge will decide later.

articles.title: Two Towns Want a New Bridge for Bikes and Walkers
articles.summary: Leaders in Ohio and West Virginia want a new bridge with a bike and walking path to replace an old, closed one.
